environment_rules.window_intervals: [start,end); positive transmission must finish no later than end
environment_rules.business_communication: all cross-node business, including Server discovery and requests, must obey directed physical windows
environment_rules.task_execution: nonpreemptive unless permitted cancellation delivered; task duration, resource constraints and failure injection unchanged
environment_rules.initial_registry: scenario-declared server-local snapshot, not a live remote-state read
environment_rules.forecasts: separate from truth; perfect_prediction means authorized initial snapshot, not knowledge of unobserved future changes
environment_rules.result_delivery: physical completion does not imply coordinator receipt
environment_rules.evaluation: independent cross-method judge required; current CO controller verdict is diagnostic only

co_ioa.forecast: known initial windows and delivered updates

ioa_original.forecast: same authorized information available; no injected CO solver decisions

co_ioa_no_forecast.candidate_tie_break: For equally optimal assignments rotate sorted capable agent IDs by paired seed modulo candidate count; objective keeps retention and earliest finish ahead of tie rank; no window data used.
co_ioa_no_forecast.unsent_dispatch_expiry: At local expiry, release only the still-unsent assignment and re-match from current simulation time; authorized requirement revision remains subject to existing scenario permissions.
co_ioa_no_forecast.formal_comparison_note: Run multiple paired seeds and report actual executor distribution. A single seed must not be chosen for favorable outcome.

reporting.completion_time: all required results received after authorized execution; not arbitrary ended_at
reporting.technical_errors: report separately; do not convert to a fast task failure
reporting.rule_runs: mechanism regression only, never real LLM comparative evidence
reporting.pairing: same scenario and external-event seed; interleave method order

budget_note: Formal budget is enforced for CO ModelAPI and native FormalOpenAIChat only when this protocol is explicitly supplied. Native original task policy is unchanged. Native max_turns=20 remains method-specific and must be reported.

common_model_budget_target.note: Attempts are counted across all native Agents in model_budget.json and in CO model_calls. Wall limit is elapsed real time since first request, checked before each attempt.

formal_design.selection_note: Mechanism coverage selected after exploratory outcomes were seen; all 13 scenarios retained in formal data and supplement.

analysis_plan.primary_effect: external_judgement.collaboration_success_rate and on_time_execution_completion_rate, reported per scenario and method
analysis_plan.time_metric: external_judgement.all_required_results_received_at for successful runs only; no imputation for failures
analysis_plan.unknown_remote_work: Keep judge failed outcome; annotate pending_remote_work or unreported physically completed task. Never relabel it success or insert a completion time.
analysis_plan.technical_error_policy: Keep every planned run and error artifact; no automatic replacement. API/adapter failures are technical_error and excluded only from conditional behavioral rates; report all-planned success as sensitivity. Any later rerun gets a new attempt ID and both attempts remain.
analysis_plan.denominator: Show planned N and behavioral valid n separately. Model-invalid and budget-exhausted runs are non-success behavioral outcomes; technical errors and not-run are excluded only from conditional behavioral rates. Physical-completion mean uses only non-null judge values, with its own n.
analysis_plan.timing_comparison: Time estimates conditional on success; paired deltas only when both methods succeed at the same scenario and repetition.
analysis_plan.cancel_and_infeasible: Cancellation and known infeasibility are distinct behaviors, not ordinary mission-success failures.
analysis_plan.display: Main 8-scene matrix plus time points; supplementary 13-scene table/matrix; failures never plotted at zero or horizon as completion time.
analysis_plan.negative_controls: hard_deadline_failure is judged by correct infeasibility recognition as well as raw mission outcome; cancel_pending_cleanup is judged by cancellation and cleanup, not mission success.
analysis_plan.success_summary: Per scenario and method report k/n among behavioral valid runs and exact planned N. If displaying an interval, use 95% Wilson score for k/n; label n. Also show all-planned k/N sensitivity with technical errors retained.
analysis_plan.completion_summary: Show each non-null judge completion ratio or its median and interquartile range, with the number of non-null observations; never turn missing judgement into zero.
analysis_plan.time_summary: For successful runs show each received-at time and median with interquartile range; no time is assigned to failure, cancellation, unknown work, budget exhaustion or technical error.
analysis_plan.cross_method: Report paired time differences only for matched scenario/repetition blocks where both methods succeeded; otherwise compare category counts, not conditional times alone. Descriptive only for n<=10.
analysis_plan.early_terminal_failure: Record terminal_certificate.rule, certified_at, task deadline/duration bounds and evaluated_until; keep ended_at and completion time null. Never score this as a technical error or as a faster task completion. Apply identically to all three methods. No certificate for active physical work, unreported completed work, future objective updates or authorized revisions.

version_note: Add one method-neutral external-judge certificate for irreversible on-time failure. It stops all three methods only when every outstanding required task has missed its latest possible physical start, all other required results are already received, no physical work is active, and no future objective update or authorized revision can change the objective. Original native IoA policy, scenarios, model settings, budgets, and schedule are unchanged. V1/V2 runs remain archived and are not pooled with V3.
